turns.q: Is there anything I should pair it with to get the best result?
turns.replyTail: Message from Smile Concierge: The best pairing depends on your treatment plan. Some doctors may recommend treatment accessories such as accelerators, but these aren’t provided by Invisalign®; your doctor can explain whether one is appropriate for your treatment and why. For day-to-day aligner care, Cleaning Crystals, the Invisalign™ Cleaning System, or an Ultrasonic Cleaner can help keep aligners clean, but they don’t replace your doctor’s treatment instructions or determine how your teeth move.
